notes: Walk-forward: each split trains only on finished matches before its start (burn-in from 2023-07-01); features use prior matches only; Elo blend weight, model family and calibration are chosen on training data only.
Test sets include ATP/WTA main draws and qualifying plus WTA 125 events (ESPN has no Challenger/ITF).
baseline_elo = pure overall Elo (no surface blend); baseline_rank_accuracy uses ESPN seed/ranking where both known.
